description: This file defines an API client for a Flutter application, including HTTP request methods (GET and POST), error handling, environment configuration, and an exception class. It facilitates communication with a backend server, managing request headers, authorization tokens, and response parsing.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, carrying HTTP status, message, URI, and cause.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Main class to perform HTTP requests (GET and POST) to a configured backend, handling headers (including authorization), response parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified API endpoint, with optional query parameters and headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified API endpoint, with a body payload and optional headers and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs the full URI for the request by combining the base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Merges default headers, authorization token if available, and additional request-specific headers.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, decoding JSON if appropriate, and throws ApiException on error status codes.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Generates a truncated preview of a string for logging purposes.
